resources.string: Scan the QR code shown on the computer (Connect phones / share online), choose a picture of it from your gallery, or type the address.\n\nEasiest: open your school\'s FaceAttend link in Chrome and tap \"Open in the FaceAttend app\".
Check that FaceAttend is running on the computer and that this phone has internet (online link) or is on the same Wi-Fi.
